items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL for Week 3 vs DEN after missing practice; Sean McVay says barring setback could return next week vs PHI.
items.why: Hip/groin; DNP Friday; Schefter/Rapoport corroborate McVay comments.
items.implication: Sit Nacua; Adams elevated to clear WR1 with massive target share as in Week 2 (195 yds/2 TD).
items.opportunity: Davante Adams high routes/targets/red-zone without Nacua.

items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels for Sunday; earlier: not IR, week-to-week after specialists, aiming return ASAP.
items.why: Dislocated elbow; no IR positive; imaging consensus.
items.implication: Mariota starts; McLaurin value holds some (25% share hist with Mariota) but tough SEA matchup.

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins (hamstring) for Sunday at IND.
items.implication: Sit Collins; Schultz becomes primary target with 28-30% share/ routes as in Week 2.
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz TE1 upside vs Colts (4th-most TE yards allowed); high TPRR.

items.text: Steelers ruled out RB Rico Dowdle (toe) vs CIN; Jaylen Warren questionable (shoulder).
items.why: Toe; official out; coach: Warren leads group.
items.implication: Warren lead back + checkdown volume; Homer/Heidenreich backups.
items.opportunity: Jaylen Warren snaps/carries/targets/third-down lead; vertical pass failing so more checkdowns.

items.text: Malik Nabers and Travis Etienne listed IN for Sunday; also Darnold, Dobbins, Harvey, Jadarian Price, Kyler, Aaron Jones.
items.why: ETR Sunday injury summary post practice reports.
items.implication: Start Nabers/Etienne with cleared status; Etienne role still limited per Berry.
items.opportunity: Full snaps/routes for Nabers; Etienne carries but low third-down hist.

items.text: Broncos: Jonah Coleman OUT (ankle); J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey off injury report, good to go vs Rams.
items.why: Official Friday report; Coleman ankle out.
items.implication: Dobbins/Harvey share lead; reverse any Coleman beneficiaries.
items.opportunity: Dobbins/Harvey carries/snaps restored; committee but both healthy.

items.text: With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren will lead Steelers RB group and stay fresh; expect checkdown spam as vertical pass failing for Rodgers. Homer + rookie Heidenreich as backups.
items.why: Coach quote on lead role; usage data on failing vertical.
items.implication: Warren RB2/flex with expanded opportunity vs CIN.

items.text: Packers first game sans Jayden Reed: Watson 45 routes, Golden 44 on 55 Love dropbacks; combined 48% targets so far.
items.implication: Watson/Golden elevated WR2/3; Berry also loves Watson.
items.opportunity: High route participation + target share/red-zone without Reed.

items.text: Loves Dalton Schultz (@IND: 28% share sans Collins, Colts allow 4th-most TE yds), Chris Olave (vs LV: double-digit tgts, high aDOT), Christian Watson (vs ATL: WR8 util, 38% RZ).
items.why: Utilization/matchup data; Collins out boosts Schultz.
items.opportunity: Schultz routes/targets sans Collins; Olave air yards; Watson RZ.

items.text: Hates Travis Etienne (vs LV: only 49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps), Rhamondre Stevenson (@JAX: 31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble), Terry McLaurin (vs SEA: fewest WR pts allowed, low team total).
items.why: Role/snap share + matchup data; Henderson out-touched post-fumble.
items.implication: Sit/flex down; Henderson rising but Stevenson still ranked ahead by Berry.
items.opportunity: Low for Etienne/Stevenson; McLaurin suppressed by SEA D + Mariota.
items.conflict: ETR lists Etienne IN but role limited.

items.text: 10 Facts: Schultz 30% routes/28% share sans Collins; London 20+ PPR/35% share/97 yds avg with Penix (12 gms); Brooks IR pushes Hubbard lead (AJ Dillon backup).
items.why: Per-player utilization/historical avgs; Brooks IR confirmed.
items.implication: Schultz must-start; London smash with Penix; Hubbard RB2.
items.opportunity: Schultz targets sans Collins; London high share; Hubbard full carries.

items.text: Week 3 projections live; Jahmyr Gibbs sets new record ceiling proj at 44.0 (avg top 25th %ile sim outcomes).
items.why: ETR sim ceiling record; updates for news.
items.opportunity: High snap/route/carry share in Lions offense.

items.text: Kyle Pitts only 63% routes this season, 6 targets/8% share through 3 games; TPRR 33% sans London vs 17% with.
items.why: Route/target share data; London on-field suppresses.
items.opportunity: London high target share/routes; Pitts limited even when active.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry (vs DAL: highest rush prop, DAL 30th rush D), Chase Brown (@PIT: 20+ touches/15% tgts both games), Brock Purdy (vs ARI: high total, ARI secondary depleted).
items.implication: Strong starts; Henry smash, Brown RB2, Purdy QB1.
items.opportunity: Henry carries vs weak run D; Brown snap/target share.
